name: recorded-module-selection-encoding
body: The recorded `--module` selection is one newline-joined string of deduped, sorted resolved roots (empty for a whole-tree scan), and both sides are whitespace-trimmed before comparison, so a rooted path embedding a newline or differing only by leading or trailing whitespace cannot be distinguished; upgrade to a length-prefixed or JSON-encoded column if such paths must round-trip.
